limo.note: round twelve: the gray stretch limousine of the Office Of Peculiar Sectors, side view, nose to the right, drawn at full size (as on row 590: 6.3 m, 575 px from end to end of the body; 'length' is bumper to bumper) through the roadside's camera exactly as it sees the car standing at its stop: laid with its foot on [345, 530] at 0.8, it is that picture. In the second frame the wheels have turned and the body rides a pixel lower; the long shadow out to the left (and the dark under the car) is part of each frame and does not move. At the stop its body runs from x 108 to x 571, and its back end is behind Mom's car (its base, 530, is above the car's). The plate on the rear bumper says O.O.P.S. Read with cast.addPicture as the wagon's frames are; the scene decides the drive.

front.foot_is: the ground under the middle of the front bumper (the same in both frames)
front.lane_is: the middle of the lane toward us (the road's far half), [x, row, scale], from the horizon to the picture's left edge (row 351), which it leaves there: the car keeps to its own side of the road
front.note: coming down the far road toward us, before it turns in: nose on, a sliver of its left side (in the sun) on the right, head lamps on. Drawn as the roadside's camera sees it with its foot at 'seen_at' (0.18 of full size), at the size it would have on row 590, and scaled by row as the side frames are. Its shadow lies out to the left, on the road. The wheels turn between the frames and the body rides a pixel lower in the second.

fx.what: two big dark birds (ravens, or a hawk) high over the desert, crossing slowly now and then: a long glide, a few slow beats. The painting had them still at [486, 150] and [702, 60], 7 and 10 px across. No base: they are behind everything

NEW (nothing was painted here): the old-timer has his coffee on, so a thin thread of woodsmoke from the stovepipe on the shack's roof. There is no wind this morning (the painting's own note: the wind sock hangs slack), so it rises nearly straight and spreads at the top

fx_note: round four: the two birds that were painted still in the sky are gone from back.png (every other pixel is as it was); 'fx' flies them, and adds a thread of smoke from the stovepipe (new). Left still on purpose: the wind sock, the umbrella, the hanging GAS sign and the tumbleweed in the fence: there is no wind this morning, and the wind sock hangs slack to say so.
